name: Card
blurb: A surface that groups a cover, a title, some text, and one action.
mechanism: Static markup: a surface, a radius, one padding step, and a rule above the footer. overflow-hidden makes a cover image inherit the corners.
caveats: A whole-card link swallows any control inside it, and a button inside an anchor is invalid HTML. Link the title, or stretch a link behind the card and hand the pointer back to the controls (this site does the latter).
